text:
Type: LED desk lamp with charging base
Use: task light for working and reading at a desk, phone charging on the base; home office, study, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, modern
Materials: white powder-coated metal arm and cylindrical head, birch veneer round base with a wireless charging pad
Colors: white, light birch wood
Shape: small cylinder head on a two-part jointed arm, round wooden disc base with a charging spot, clean and angular, compact
Feel: practical, clean, fresh, calm
Goes with: white or light wood desks, pastel accents, white walls; Scandinavian or minimalist home offices
